title: FAA orders nationwide ground stop for all US flight departures
summary: The grounding was the first nationwide flight stoppage since January 2023, when an FAA computer system malfunctioned. Before that, the last nationwide grounding followed the terrorist attacks of Sept. 11, 2001.

title: US Democrats direct Musk to preserve records on Ukraine's Starlink restriction, WSJ reports
summary: "The October and November restrictions now raise the disturbing possibility that these vulnerabilities persist even within systems on which the U.S. government relies," Senators Jeanne Shaheen and Chris Coons wrote.

title: Historic first summit for Trump, Xi, Putin will not focus on Ukraine, White House says
summary: A U.S. official said that a trilateral meeting has been planned, but will focus on nuclear non-proliferation and the war in Iran.

title: US Air Force responds to suspected drone activity at military base in UK
summary: The U.S. Air Force has maintained a presence at the base since 1948, as part of the longstanding military partnership between the United States and the United Kingdom.
